uncertainty: Six pinned open-source Maven package paths, jPLY 0.2.0, MeshIO 2.1.2, mesh-ply 1.1.0, pcutil 0.3.0, LWJGL Assimp 3.4.3, and MonkeyWrench 1.0.1, each parsed the valid ASCII PLY triangle and returned three vertices, one face and face indices [0,1,2]. Fourteen more verified paths are needed for the 20-path working target. Four bounded Maven Central searches saved seven unique name hits; some queries timed out and successful snapshots were retained across refreshes. Search names are not parser proof; MeshIO, pcutil and MonkeyWrench came from project documentation. The Ardor3D PLY importer remains an unresolved lead. LWJGL and MonkeyWrench share Assimp's PLY parser family with the C++ Assimp path; MonkeyWrench has a 65-jar pinned Maven runtime classpath and LWJGL uses pinned macOS arm64 native artifacts. deps.dev exact-release public direct dependents are 13 for LWJGL Assimp and zero for the other five; this metric may omit adoption and does not measure PLY use. Only a triangle with float vertices and one face was demonstrated; other PLY properties and binary PLY are untested. No malformed-input, resource-use, or vulnerability experiments were run.
